subject: Request: Ellora Health combined credit top-up + promo discount (exec review)
messages:
From: Susan Lee <susan.lee@ellorahealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@ellorahealth.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ellora trial extension + credits / discount request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and the data isolation options. We ran a short sandbox over the past week and attached Q4 usage as requested (Ellora_Usage_Report_Q4.csv).

Two asks from our side so we can move to a funded POC and accelerate legal/procurement:

- 45-day extension to the trial window (current trial ends in ~10 days).
- $40k in sandbox credits to cover higher token usage during model evaluation and integration with our PHI pipelines.
- A promotional 20% discount on year-1 committed usage if we convert to a 12-month commit within 60 days after the POC.

Procurement has signaled we need some commercial concessions to make the internal business case — the combination above would let us validate model behavior on deidentified clinical transcripts and move forward with a security review.

Can you route this for executive approval? If helpful, I can share a short one-pager on anticipated usage patterns.

Thanks,
Susan Lee
Head of Data Platforms, Ellora Health
Susan.Lee@ellorahealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Ellora_Usage_Report_Q4.csv (csv, 74KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jan 2028 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Ellora trial extension + credits / discount request — request for exec review

Team — forwarding Ellora's ask. TL;DR: 45-day extension + $40k credits + 20% first-year promo if they commit to 12 months within 60 days. They justify with PHI workflow validation and expected ramp.

Why I recommend approving (summary):
- Upside: Ellora is a mid-sized regional provider with a credible roadmap to convert; procurement timeline is 6–8 weeks and this concession materially shortens evaluation risk.
- Expected ARR if converted: ~$220k ARR year-1 (conservative).
- Risk: credits usage could be front-loaded; however we can gate by limiting credits to sandbox models and require tagging/ingestion protections.

Proposed package (my recommendation):
- 45-day trial extension,
- $30k free credits (rather than $40k requested) with usage-flagging and weekly consumption reporting,
- 15% promotional discount on year-1 committed spend (compromise),
- Require signed MOU and security attestation before credits activated.

I'm attaching a Draft_MAP_v2.pdf and a rough impact calc. If you prefer to meet, I can get Ellora on a 20-minute call.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Senior Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachments: Draft_MAP_v2.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jan 2028 11:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Ellora — credit/discount asks (impact & recommendation)

Thanks Naomi — useful summary. I ran a quick back-of-envelope on unit economics and attached the sheet (credit_impact_estimate.xlsx). Key notes:

- $40k credits fully granted up-front has ~3.2% short-term hit to bookings if they convert; $30k is ~2.4% — both manageable.
- 20% promo on year-1 is a larger structural concession; 15% is more palatable and leaves negotiating room.
- If we tie credit release to milestones (MAP sign + security attestation + first integration checkpoint) we reduce abuse and make procurement comfortable.

I approve the compromise Naomi proposed (45 days, $30k credits, 15% year-1 discount) conditional on Ops/Legal sign-off and a short SOW/MOU. Marissa — can you confirm we're OK from an ops/billing standpoint and push the MOU template?

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | VP Revenue, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jan 2028 09:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Ellora — credit/discount asks (ops + legal checklist)

Agree with Aditya's conditional approval. Operational notes / steps I'll take:
1) Draft MOU (MOU_Ellora_Redwood.docx) with the following gating conditions before credits are drawn down:
   - Signed MOU + Scope of Evaluation (MAP attached)
   - Security attestation signoff from Ellora security (we need contact + timeline)
   - Weekly usage reporting and tagging for sandbox traffic (we'll set alerts at 60% of allotted credits)
2) Billing: create a restricted promo credit bucket for DEAL-2028-0421 (30k). Credits expire 90 days from activation.
3) Legal: I'll loop in legal for a quick review of the MOU template; expedited review requested.

If no objections from Aditya or Karthik by EOD, I will prepare the MOU and route a DocuSign link.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 29 Jan 2028 15:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Approved: Ellora sandbox top-up + promo (conditional)

Hi Susan — good news: Redwood can approve a combined package to help you complete the POC. Conditional details below.

Approved package (conditional):
- 45-day trial extension from your current expiry date
- $30,000 sandbox credits to be applied to DEAL-2028-0421 (credits are in a restricted bucket)
- 15% promotional discount on year-1 committed spend if Ellora signs a 12-month commitment within 60 days after POC completion

Gating conditions (credits will be activated only after we receive):
1) Signed MOU (DocuSign) specifying scope, data handling constraints, and acceptance criteria (link will be sent by Marissa).
2) Security attestation from Ellora security team confirming the sandbox contains only deidentified data for the evaluation.
3) Weekly usage report for the sandbox during the credit period; automated alerts at 60% consumption.

Marissa will send the DocuSign for the MOU (MOU_Ellora_Redwood.docx) and Ops will provision the restricted credit bucket once the MOU is signed. Legal will perform a short review.

If this sounds good, procurement can expect the DocuSign link today and credits will be activated within 24 hours of signed MOU + attestation.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Ellora across the finish line.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
